forage.text: Forage the woods for mushrooms and herbs

office.description: 1 phase · counts as a talk with Elena
office.log: You spent the morning in the office with the papers.

surveyFields.log: You walked every plot of it.

surveyForest.log: You went through the woods and wrote down what you saw.

deepLedger.text: Trace the payments in the ledger
deepLedger.description: That regular “sundry maintenance” — you still have no name to put to it
deepLedger.log: You followed the unexplained payment through the ledger. The numbers themselves do not lie, but the way they were entered says a great deal.

market.goDescription: The ride takes the morning and the afternoon both. The cart carries {cap} units a trip
market.goLog: You set out for the market at Valehold.

market.sellTimberLog: You sold {n} units of timber at market for {revenue} guldmark.

market.capacityFull: The cart is full (a trip carries {cap})
market.finishSoldLog: You settled the day’s accounts and drove the empty cart back to Maplegate.
market.finishIdleLog: You went round the market and traded nothing.
market.capacityLeftOne: The cart will take {n} more unit (a trip carries {cap})

hunt.log: You rode to the ducal hunting ground and joined the day’s field.
hunt.tooTired: You are too worn out to ride to the hunt

dinner.text: Ride to Thornwall for the dinner
dinner.log: You changed your clothes and rode to Thornwall.

boundary.text: Go and look at the north woods
boundary.log: You went out to the north woods.

talkMarta.description: The inside of the estate. Martha knows everything
talkMarta.descriptionOpen: Martha talks more than she used to — that is what trust looks like
talkMarta.log: You sat with Martha in the kitchen a while.

talkGregor.log: You spent a while at the stable with Gregor.

helpHorses.text: Lend a hand at the stable
helpHorses.description: 1 phase · counts as a talk with Gregor
helpHorses.log: You worked half the day at the stable alongside Gregor.

visitLorenz.description: 1 phase · counts as a talk with Lorenz
visitLorenz.log: You went to the forge-chapel and talked with Lorenz a while.

chapel.vigilText: Keep the vigil with Lorenz at the forge-chapel
chapel.vigilDescription: 1 phase · counts as a talk with Lorenz
chapel.vigilLog: You sat the night’s fire with Lorenz at the forge-chapel.
chapel.log: You tended the fire at the estate forge-chapel a while, and thought.

reviewAccounts.text: Go over the accounts at night
reviewAccounts.log: You went over the accounts by lamplight, late.

rest.description: Clears all fatigue. Tomorrow you are rested

grainToGold.description: 6 grain + 1 timber for 4 guldmark (a poor emergency rate)
grainToGold.descriptionShort: 6 grain + 1 timber for 4 guldmark — not enough in store
grainToGold.log: You put grain through the resident broker for coin at the emergency rate. Packing and carriage came out of the timber.

timberToGold.description: 3 timber for 3 guldmark (worked first, then sold on at a discount)
timberToGold.descriptionShort: 3 timber for 3 guldmark — not enough in store
timberToGold.log: You had the resident broker sell the timber on at a discount. Nothing like the market price, but there is no other road just now.

timberToGrain.description: 2 timber + 1 guldmark for 7 grain (carted from a neighbouring estate, fair enough)
timberToGrain.descriptionShort: 2 timber + 1 guldmark for 7 grain — not enough in store
timberToGrain.log: You had the broker cart in grain from a neighbouring estate. The carriage was settled in coin, and the timber went against the goods.
